cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a street food stall at night under a tarp — holds a bowl of hot food at chest height; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — dries her hair with a towel; a rocky coast path with tide pools — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a medieval tavern — holds her keepsake at chest height; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — sitting on the ground; a sheltered coastal ferry waiting area with coloured glass wind screens — she holds a paper pinwheel against the breeze to pass the wait; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — holds her keepsake at chest height; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — kneeling on the ground; a convention photo zone under ring lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a self-service car wash bay — standing; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — holds a stone between two fingertips near her lips
